mentions.name: Shared hosting for vibe-coded programs
mentions.description: This platform provides shared hosting for vibe-coded programs, combining an old-school LAMP-stack shared host with a parse-like library for capabilities such as push notifications, so tiny apps, scripts, and cron jobs can be accessed from any internet-connected device. The end goal is that users tell their AI agent of choice to make their app deployable, and the agent adapts it to the platform's library methods and deploys it automatically.
mentions.problem: Making personally vibe-coded apps, scripts, and cron jobs available across multiple devices over the internet; the biggest open challenge is safely deploying remote code without compromising the server.
mentions.audience: People who build small vibe-coded apps, scripts, and cron jobs and want them running on any internet-connected device.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently fleshing out the idea for a "shared hosting" for vibe coded programs - something like a cross between an old school LAMP stack shared host and a parse like library for capabilities like push notifications.
